definition: startable_rate = share of the player's JUDGED 2025 weeks in which he outscored this league's own baseline at his position that real week (QB12/RB31/WR51/TE14). A week with fewer than N players at the position has no baseline and is excluded from numerator and denominator; weeks_judged reports how many weeks actually counted.

weekly_source.note: week keys are the real NFL week from the API row, not a list index
